description: This file defines the RequestHandler class implementing the PSR-15 request handler invocation strategy within the Slim Framework. It manages invoking callables with optional route argument injection into the request attributes.

classes.name: RequestHandler
classes.description: Implements the PSR-15 invocation strategy for request handlers, optionally appending route arguments to the request attributes before invocation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the handler with an option to append route arguments to request attributes.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the given callable with the request, optionally injecting route arguments into the request attributes.
